# Avatar

A person or an agent, at 24, 32, 40 or 48.

## Use
- People are round (`radius-round`, `bg-band`, initials in `fg-default`). Agents are square (`radius-control`, `section-plug`, a sparkles mark in ink). The shape tells a reader at a glance whether a human or an AI is speaking.
- Photos replace the fill; alt text is the person's name.
